name: flow/signup-flow
title: Signup flow
desc_vi: Thẻ đăng ký trồi lên, sáu dòng (tiêu đề, nút mạng xã hội, dòng chia, ô email, ô mật khẩu, nút gửi) hiện lần lượt, nút gửi bấm nhẹ một lần.
params_vi: title, social, or, email, password, submit: chữ · ink, onInk, muted, border, surface: màu · scale: độ phóng to (2.2)
notes: Layout, colours, radii, spacing and the three tweens are as in the source (card y 26 + opacity, 0.36 s power2.out at 0.25 s; the six rows y 14 + opacity, 0.24 s power2.out, stagger 0.05 at 0.48 s; submit scale 1 -> 0.97 yoyo repeat 1, 0.12 s power1.inOut at 1.2 s, written as a fromTo with explicit start scale). Where the source demo differs from the snippet its value is used (field / button font 15 px weight 600, divider 13 px weight 500, divider text italic as the em element renders); the demo's 2.2x enlargement is the param `scale` (a wrapper with transform: scale that is never tweened). Font: the film's font instead of Inter. The source buttons are button elements and the divider rules are spans; here all are div / i elements with the same boxes. The social button text keeps the source's wording ('Tiếp tục với Google'); the source draws no logo. Content as params with Vietnamese defaults (source: English).
